description: Source code for grpc-gateway runtime context handling, including context annotation, metadata management, and HTTP header validation.

methods.name: WithHTTPPathPattern
methods.description: Returns an AnnotateContextOption that sets the HTTP path pattern in the context.

methods.name: decodeBinHeader
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded binary header value, handling padding if necessary.

methods.name: AnnotateContext
methods.description: Adds context information and metadata from an HTTP request for outgoing gRPC calls.

methods.name: AnnotateIncomingContext
methods.description: Adds context information and metadata from an HTTP request for incoming gRPC calls.

methods.name: isValidGRPCMetadataKey
methods.description: Checks if a header key is valid for gRPC metadata.

methods.name: isValidGRPCMetadataTextValue
methods.description: Checks if a header value is valid ASCII for gRPC metadata.

methods.name: annotateContext
methods.description: Constructs context with metadata and timeout based on HTTP request headers.

methods.name: NewServerMetadataContext
methods.description: Creates a new context embedding server metadata.

methods.name: timeoutDecode
methods.description: Decodes a gRPC timeout string into a time.Duration.

methods.name: timeoutUnitToDuration
methods.description: Converts a timeout unit character to a time.Duration.

methods.name: isPermanentHTTPHeader
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP header is a permanent header as per IANA.

methods.name: isMalformedHTTPHeader
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP header is considered malformed for gRPC.

methods.name: RPCMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the gRPC method string from context.

methods.name: withRPCMethod
methods.description: Stores the gRPC method string into context.

methods.name: HTTPPathPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP path pattern string from context.

methods.name: withHTTPPathPattern
methods.description: Stores the HTTP path pattern string into context.

methods.name: HTTPPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP pattern struct from context.

methods.name: withHTTPPattern
methods.description: Stores the HTTP pattern struct into context.
